source.license_note: Real upstream VictoriaMetrics optimization PR #5721; measured-speedup task.

task.summary: Speed up MarshalVarInt64s in lib/encoding so it stops looping byte-by-byte to emit each varint, without changing the encoded output.
task.instructions: Optimize the lib/encoding package for speed WITHOUT changing behavior. The benchmark BenchmarkMarshalVarInt64s measures it; existing tests must still pass.
task.acceptance_notes: Behavior preserved (go test passes); higher measured speedup is better. Do NOT edit any *_test.go.

code_fault.description: MarshalVarInt64s in lib/encoding/int.go emits each varint with a per-byte append loop instead of computing the encoded length up front and writing all bytes in one switch case. Note: the lib/encoding package needs CGO_ENABLED=1 because it pulls in lib/encoding/zstd cgo bindings.

ops_fault.description: Varint marshaling of int64 slices in lib/encoding/int.go uses a byte-at-a-time append loop in MarshalVarInt64s, which is slower than computing the output length once and emitting all bytes together.
detection_keywords: per-byte shift loop in varint encoding
repair_keywords: emit all varint bytes in one append

visible_context.issue_text: Marshaling slices of int64 values to varint form via MarshalVarInt64s shows up as a hot spot on ingestion and storage paths in VictoriaMetrics.
visible_context.notes: Real upstream optimization PR; benchmark BenchmarkMarshalVarInt64s already exists in the repo.
